lead_raw_text:
The orthorhombic crystal Gd4Mg12Mo2 (Gd2Mg6Mo) adopts space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all Gd, Mg, and Mo centers in 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg–Mg coordination dominated by short 3.19–3.39 Å contacts. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Gd- and Mg-centered polyhedra.
